title: Transferring Miles Between Summit Members
content:
A Crestline Summit Loyalty Program member may transfer award miles to another person's Summit membership.

**Amount.** Transfers are made in whole multiples of the transfer increment, and at least the smallest transfer, in one transfer.

**Status of both memberships.** Miles can be transferred out only from a membership whose status is active on the membership record, and only to a recipient membership whose status is enrolled or active.

**Annual limit.** The miles transferred out in the calendar year, together with the new transfer, may not exceed the most miles the sender's tier may transfer out in one calendar year. The calendar year runs from January 1 to December 31, US Central time, and the miles already transferred are the sum of the miles on the sender's transfer-out entries dated inside it.

**Fees.** The sender pays the tier's fee per 1000 miles for each thousand miles transferred, plus the tier's processing fee per transfer; together they are recorded as the fee on the transfer-out entry. The recipient pays nothing.

**Finality.** A completed transfer is final and is never reversed on request, and transferred miles never earn qualifying dollars. Transfers count as qualifying activity for both memberships.

| Check | Record that decides | Passes when |
|---|---|---|
| Sender status | Sender's membership | Active |
| Recipient status | Recipient's membership | Enrolled or active |
| Annual limit | Sender's transfer-out entries this calendar year | Their miles together with the new transfer do not exceed the tier limit |

**Hypothetical case.** A sender whose tier allows 100000 miles a year has transferred 96000 miles since January 1. A new transfer of 4000 miles brings the year to exactly 100000 and is within the limit; a transfer of 5000 miles would bring it to 101000 and is not.
